## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D0. This is audit backlog UX-35 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: No screen. Readers: every developer and AI agent that writes front-end code; the founder as owner of the rules.
Findings and reviewers: F-45, F-19, F-20, F-21 · reviewers B-27, C-04, C-05, C-11 · arbitration rulings 2, 5, 6 and 8.
Rationale: There is no written rule for density, page headers, card sizes, how many primary buttons a view may have, or which shared component a pattern must use. That is why three patient headers, 20 view switches and about 350 size patches exist. Everything else in track D builds on these rules, so they are written first.
Proposed UX behaviour: Two short files at the repository root. PRODUCT.md: who uses Medvya (doctor, nurse, receptionist, owner, practice admin), what each must be able to do all day, the eight design principles of blueprint section 1, the device strategy of section 11 and the phone rule of ruling 5. DESIGN.md: the layout grid and widths (section 2), navigation model (3), the two densities (4), spacing, type, radius and elevation (5), tone meanings (6), the component list with states (7), pinned chrome rules (10), motion rules with the never list (12), the accessibility targets by WCAG 2.2 criterion (13) and the guardrails (14). Both files carry the non-negotiables of the epic and the list headed Do not change without clinical validation. AGENTS.md section 4 is amended in the same change for the rules that change: 44 px is the library default and a feature never patches a control height; comfortable density is mandatory for every control that changes state, every row that picks a patient, medicine lines and any device with a coarse pointer; compact 36 px rows are allowed only on the audit log, formulary, order sets and staff tables; typed clinical text is 16 px; 1024 px is a named layout tier and sm:grid-cols is not used for column changes; the shared components that a feature must use once they exist, each with the ticket that builds it; one primary button per view; pinned chrome takes at most 30 % of the height and nothing focusable sits under it; the motion tokens and the never list; a new shared component is not done until it is in the /__ui gallery in English and Arabic. docs/02-design/tokens.md gets one line at the top saying DESIGN.md describes the build and wins where they differ.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md, all sections; docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html as the picture of the target; docs/product-ux-audit/12-prototype-guide.md (What the concept deliberately does not settle).
Components and tokens affected: None built here. Names every component and token group that waves D1 to D3 build.
Front end and back end split: Docs only. No front-end or back-end code.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None. This is the first ticket of track D; every other track D ticket depends on it through the lint and ratchet ticket of the same wave.
Clinical sign-off: Not required to write the rules. The allergy presentation and the strip contents are recorded as proposals that wait for questions 3 and 4 of docs/product-ux-audit/11-pilot-doctor-validation-plan.md.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. Docs only; the risk is writing a rule the code cannot yet meet, so each such rule names the ticket that makes it true.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Any change to packages/ui or to a screen. (2) The lint rules and the CI count (the next ticket of this wave). (3) A palette or typeface change, or a second component library: both are forbidden by the rules being written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the repository root, when PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md are opened, then each section of blueprint sections 1 to 14 is present in one of them and docs/README.md and AGENTS.md section 8 link to both
- [ ] **AC2.** Given DESIGN.md, when the density, phone, navigation rail and owner page rules are read, then they match arbitration rulings 2, 5, 8 and 7 word for word in meaning and name the four tables that may be compact
- [ ] **AC3.** Given AGENTS.md section 4, when it is read after this change, then it states the 44 px library default, the two densities, 16 px typed clinical text, the 1024 tier, the shared components to use and the motion rules, and each rule the code does not yet meet names the ticket that makes it true
- [ ] **AC4.** Given DESIGN.md, when the list headed Do not change without clinical validation is read, then it holds every item of blueprint section 14 and of the executive verdict, and the epic's seven non-negotiables
- [ ] **AC5.** Given DESIGN.md, when the accessibility section is read, then it lists the WCAG 2.2 criteria of blueprint section 13 as design requirements and makes no claim of conformance
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the changed Markdown files, when python3 -I tools/check-links/check.py runs, then it reports 0 broken links
